newsitem.title: TURKEY: Turk appeal court backs sentence on writer Kemal.
newsitem.headline: Turk appeal court backs sentence on writer Kemal.

text.p: A Turkish appeals court on Friday confirmed a 20-month suspended jail sentence given to the country's best-known living author for a breach of tough freedom of expression laws, the writer said.
The ruling came a day after Turkey promised to clean up its human rights record, under fire from the West.

Author Yasar Kemal told Reuters the court had upheld his sentencing by a State Security Court in March for writing an article in a book on freedom of expression. The article was deemed to have promoted Kurdish separatism.
"This can occur only in a closed system. My article calls on peace, seeks ways of ending the prolonged bloody war and I am found guilty for provoking separatism. Can you believe it?" he said.
"I do not believe in the division of the state," he said.

Turkey cracks down hard on Kurdish dissent, both peaceful and violent. Troops and Kurdish guerrillas have been fighting in the mountains of southeast Turkey for the last 12 years. More than 20,000 people have died.
Kemal's sentence was suspended for five years on the condition that he did not repeat the offence. Kemal, author of the internationally-known novel "Memed, My Hawk", vowed he would not be silenced.
"The court orders me not to write for five years without imprisoning me, but that is killing me," he said.
"I know whatever I write, even an innocent sentence like, 'The yellow flower opens at the skirt of the mountain', they will find me guilty for it. But I will not give in." he added.
Foreign Minister Tansu Ciller promised on Thursday to bring human rights in Turkey up to international standards.
Turkey lifted some of its restraints on freedom of expression last year as a condition for a lucrative trade deal with the European Union.
But the European Parliament has threatened to block EU aid to Ankara, partly for what Euro MPs say is Turkey's failure to keep promises to improve its human rights performance.
